bluf: Russian deep strikes on Ukrainian energy targets and hybrid maritime pressure in the Black Sea and Hormuz will sustain through the week, with shipping insurance costs rising further. Houthi-Saudi exchanges near Bab el-Mandeb remain the most active secondary front. The single biggest risk is a successful Houthi ballistic strike on a Saudi oil or airport facility that forces visible coalition retaliation.

forecasts.event: Ukrainian General Staff or Russian MoD confirms at least one new long-range strike on a Russian energy facility or airbase
basis: Samara oil facility blaze already reported
ongoing Ukrainian drone claims in Telegram channels
forecasts.watch_for: Russian MoD Telegram post on intercepted drones or fires
forecasts.wrong_if: No new Russian energy or airbase damage claims in next 24h

forecasts.event: UKMTO or gCaptain reports at least one new tanker strike or boarding attempt in Strait of Hormuz
basis: attacks already at record weekly levels
forecasts.watch_for: new UKMTO alert or vessel AIS anomaly
forecasts.wrong_if: No new Hormuz incident reported by 08 Oct 19:00 UTC

forecasts.event: Saudi MoD or Houthi statement confirms successful ballistic missile impact on Saudi airport or oil facility
basis: recent Houthi launches toward Abha, Khamis Mushait, Riyadh
forecasts.watch_for: Saudi MoD interception failure report or Houthi claim of hit
forecasts.wrong_if: All Houthi missiles intercepted with no confirmed ground impact by 10 Oct

forecasts.event: Ethiopian federal or TPLF statement acknowledges Eritrean troop deployment in Tigray
basis: local witness reports of Eritrean presence near Adigrat
forecasts.watch_for: official Ethiopian statement or TPLF denial
forecasts.wrong_if: No Eritrean involvement statement from either side by 10 Oct

forecasts.event: Bulgarian or UKMTO report confirms additional vessel struck by drone in Black Sea EEZ
basis: Alfa Watan search ended, Able still at risk
forecasts.wrong_if: No new Black Sea vessel incident by 10 Oct

forecasts.event: Kyiv reports power or water outages affecting at least three additional oblasts beyond current disruptions
forecasts.watch_for: Ukrenergo or local oblast emergency declarations
forecasts.wrong_if: No expansion of reported outages by 14 Oct

forecasts.event: Taiwan MND reports a single day with 25+ PLA aircraft sorties and 15+ median-line crossings
forecasts.watch_for: Taiwan MND daily summary exceeding threshold
forecasts.wrong_if: No day reaches 25 sorties by 14 Oct

forecasts.event: Pakistan or Turkey announces troop deployment to Saudi Arabia in response to Houthi attacks
basis: earlier reports of agreement to deploy

pre_headline.signal: PoeLLM malware campaign expanding against exposed AI servers for cryptomining
pre_headline.why: may trigger new CISA alerts or enterprise AI security patches within week

pre_headline.signal: Local Tigray accounts posting photos of Eritrean units near Wekro but no numbers or intent confirmed
pre_headline.why: could precede Ethiopian federal statement on external involvement

pre_headline.signal: Bulgarian maritime authorities still listing Able as at risk after Alfa Watan loss
pre_headline.why: next drone strike would likely prompt NATO Black Sea patrol increase

nuclear.why: No new nuclear-adjacent activity, deployments, or rhetoric in any theatre; all strategic radio monitors quiet.

recent.event: Taiwan MND reports 25 or more PLA aircraft sorties with 15+ median-line crossings in a single day

open.event: UKMTO or gCaptain reports at least one additional unknown-projectile strike on a tanker in the Strait of Hormuz
Houthi forces claim at least one ballistic-missile strike on a Saudi target with reported casualties
Ukrainian General Staff or Kyiv Independent reports at least one new long-range drone or missile strike on a Russian air base or oil facility
At least two additional commercial vessels damaged or sunk by drone strikes off Bulgaria or Romania
Reuters or Addis/Asmara statements confirm Eritrean military involvement in northern Tigray clashes
CISA or utility operator reports at least one confirmed operational disruption from SharePoint CVE-2026-65660 exploitation
Polish MOD announces operational status for the new Patriot battery in Lublin region
